source_evidence: Another type of retirement saving account is one that you set up yourself, known as an Individual Retirement Account or IRA. You can invest in your own tax-advantaged investment account to provide financial security when you retire. IRA contributions can also reduce the amount you pay in taxes.
question: What is an Individual Retirement Account (IRA), and what tax benefit may its contributions provide?
answer: An IRA is a retirement savings account that you set up yourself. It is a tax-advantaged investment account intended to help provide financial security in retirement, and contributions may reduce the amount you pay in taxes.
